name: 01 - META - Theo dõi & Đồng bộ Hội thoại Fanpage vào Supabase

nodes.name: Bấm Để Kiểm tra & Đồng bộ Ngay
Tự động kiểm tra mỗi 15 phút
1. Lấy danh sách hội thoại từ Meta Page

parameters.query:
SELECT
  coalesce(c.id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid) AS db_conversation_id,
  $1 AS external_user_id,
  c.last_message_at,
  count(m.id)::int AS db_message_count,
  coalesce(max(m.created_at)::text, '') AS db_last_message_at
FROM (SELECT $1::text AS ext_id) inp
LEFT JOIN conversations c ON c.channel_account_id = '20000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'::uuid AND c.external_user_id = inp.ext_id
LEFT JOIN conversation_messages m ON m.conversation_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.external_user_id, c.last_message_at;

nodes.name: 3. Đọc số liệu hiện tại từ Supabase
4. So sánh trạng thái đồng bộ

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS data
),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO conversations (organization_id, chatbot_id, channel_account_id, external_user_id, status, mode, started_at, last_message_at, metadata)
  SELECT
    '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid,
    '10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid,
    '20000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'::uuid,
    data->>'customer_id',
    'active',
    'AI',
    (data->>'fb_updated_time')::timestamptz,
    (data->>'fb_updated_time')::timestamptz,
    jsonb_build_object('customer_name', data->>'customer_name')
  FROM input
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM conversations existing
    WHERE existing.channel_account_id = '20000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'::uuid
      AND existing.external_user_id = (data->>'customer_id')
  )
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT coalesce(
  (SELECT id FROM ins),
  (SELECT id FROM conversations WHERE channel_account_id = '20000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'::uuid AND external_user_id = ($1::jsonb->>'customer_id'))
) AS conversation_id;

nodes.name: 5. Đảm bảo Conversation tồn tại trong DB

parameters.url: ={{ 'https://graph.facebook.com/v26.0/' + $('4. So sánh trạng thái đồng bộ').item.json.fb_conversation_id + '/messages?fields=id,message,created_time,from,attachments&limit=100' }}

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS data
)
INSERT INTO conversation_messages (conversation_id, sender_type, role, content, external_message_id, created_at, attachments, metadata)
SELECT
  (data->>'conversation_id')::uuid,
  data->>'sender_type',
  data->>'role',
  data->>'content',
  data->>'external_message_id',
  (data->>'created_at')::timestamptz,
  coalesce((data->>'attachments')::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb),
  '{}'::jsonb
FROM input
WHERE data->>'external_message_id' IS NOT NULL
  AND data->>'conversation_id' IS NOT NULL
  AND nullif(trim(data->>'content'), '') IS NOT NULL
ON CONFLICT (conversation_id, external_message_id) WHERE (external_message_id IS NOT NULL) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;
